name: h1_hover_normal_coverage_v1
class_prior: Normal weights rescaled so total normal mass = 83051 (M0); fault probability stays 0.48756. normal_flight and prefault pools each keep half of normal mass; refill only redistributes inside normal_flight. Target hover>30s normal mass 1.50% -> ~5.2%.
single_change: Append 19573 refill windows (train independent-normal hover cases, stride-5, cap64 starts excluded) as normal_flight before Balanced weights

success_criteria.primary_2: >=8/12 late hover cases lower >30s FPR than M0 B, and >=4/6 pair groups lower in both domains
success_criteria.constraint_4: each of six fault classes recall drop <= 1.0pp; SIL and HIL recall drop <= 0.5pp each
success_criteria.constraint_6: independent normal FP in non-hover directories <= 168 (M0 B 138 + 30)

decisions_taken_without_explicit_reply: small-tolerance recall constraints instead of zero-drop
